metadata.Name: JAFFE Dataset
metadata.License: Non Commercial Use - ELRA END USER
metadata.Description: The JAFFE dataset is a set of images depicting facial expressions posed by Japanese women, accompanied by semantic ratings on nouns describing the expressions.
metadata.Paper Title: Excavating AI Re-excavated: Debunking a Fallacious Account of the JAFFE Dataset
metadata.Abstract: The JAFFE dataset was created for a study on face perception and has been misused in art exhibitions and essays without proper permission or understanding of its creation and purpose. This article recounts the creation of JAFFE, refutes fallacious statements made about it, and discusses its use in research on facial expression, affective computing, and human-computer interaction.
